newsitem.title: USA: Dow rises on Philip Morris, other stocks lower.
newsitem.headline: Dow rises on Philip Morris, other stocks lower.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average opened slightly higher on Monday, boosted by Philip Morris, which gained four to 92. Other shares were slightly lower, mirroring bonds.
The Dow was up eight to 5,731, while the NASDAQ Index was off fractionally to 1,143 and the S&P Index down one to 666.
New York Stock Exchange advances lagged declines by 476/698 while NASDAQ advances led declines 837/763.
The 30-year U.S. Treasury bond was off 2/32 to yield 6.96 percent.
